_note: Newest first. date is YYYY-MM or YYYY. text may contain simple HTML links. Items after the first 6 are hidden behind 'Show older news'.

items.text: Paper accepted in IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing with Zekun Long and colleagues: Geometry-Conditioned Implicit Spatial–Frequency Fusion Network for Hyperspectral–LiDAR Classification (GFFNet).
Joined Frontiers in Remote Sensing as Associate Editor in the Multi- and Hyper-Spectral Imaging section.
Survey published in Computer Science Review (impact factor 17.5), online from 3 November: Spectral 3D Computer Vision: A Survey of Acquisition, Representations, Learning, and Applications.
Call for papers open for AI for Agriculture, an SN Computer Science collection I lead as guest editor; submissions close 31 May 2027.
Code for HyperRadar (ECCV 2026, multi-view radar segmentation) is now public.
Code for TopoOT, TopoTTA, MAFR and MM-HCAN is now public.
TopoOT accepted at NeurIPS 2026 as a main-conference poster. See you in Sydney.
“Learnable Persistent Topology for Multi-View Radar Semantic Segmentation” accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations.
La Trobe University featured our HyperRadar research on making autonomous systems more reliable: AI and autonomous systems.
Paper with Zaid Sako and Nilmini Wickramasinghe accepted at HICSS-60: Context-Aware AI for Localised Pollen-Risk Guidance in Asthma Self-Management.
Editorial published in Frontiers in Remote Sensing: Building resilient cities with remote sensing and AI, closing the Research Topic I co-edited.
La Trobe University featured our work on higher-order, structure-aware AI: AI systems and real-world data.
Joined the editorial board of SN Computer Science (Springer Nature) as Associate Editor, and serving as area chair for DICTA 2026.
Recognised as an ICML 2026 Silver Reviewer and received a CVPR 2026 reviewer certificate. More in awards and recognition.
Our tutorial Topological Deep Learning for Robust Representation Learning was accepted at ACML 2026 (Melbourne, 1 December), with Abdelwahed Khamis (CSIRO).
TopoTTA published in IEEE TPAMI.
Papers at ECCV 2026 (structurally consistent multi-view radar segmentation) and IEEE JBHI (expert fusion for blastocyst assessment and IVF decision support).
MM-HCAN published in the IEEE Sensors Journal; HyperEcho, on higher-order representations for automotive radar, at IEEE PerCom 2026.
Seed funding as lead for SpectraResist-AI, detecting herbicide resistance in ryegrass, and a La Trobe Research Infrastructure grant for a high-speed camera.
Best Student Paper Award (APRS/IEEE) at DICTA 2025 in Adelaide, with Derrick Effah, for weakly supervised pixel-wise classification of hyperspectral images.
Programme committee for IVCNZ 2025 and scientific committee for the 2026 Australian Agronomy Conference.
MAFR and Split-Fuse-Transport at DICTA 2025; Hierarchical Spatial Mamba at ACPR 2025; BioNet and NeFF at WACV 2025.
Poster session lead at DICTA 2024 in Perth.
Our review of topological deep learning appeared in Artificial Intelligence Review, and TopoX in the Journal of Machine Learning Research.
Runner-up paper award at DICTA 2023 for contrastive-aware ViT for weakly supervised segmentation.
